# prune

The daily `source-digest.prune` job: runs `pruneSourceFacts`
(`source-digest/cli`) in a supervised child, main only — deletes the shared
facts store's rows unread for 14 days, a page at a time, each page's deletes
one short transaction. No reader prunes: the prune used to run inside every
process's first open of the UTC day, and the processes opening the store just
after midnight raced for one whole-table DELETE, the losers throwing
`database is locked` (2026-11-18). Each run logs one line to
`logs/source-digest-prune.jsonl`.
